sections.content: Combine hypothetical conditions, conditional consequences and alternative possibilities to imagine different choices or situations.

items.spanish: Si tuviera otra oportunidad, cambiaría mi decisión.
items.english: If I had another opportunity, I would change my decision.

items.spanish: Podría elegir otra alternativa si fuera posible.
items.english: I could choose another alternative if it were possible.

items.spanish: Si pudiera elegir entre varias alternativas, preferiría la que me permitiera aprender algo nuevo.
items.english: If I could choose between several alternatives, I would prefer the one that would let me learn something new.

sections.content: The *si* clause doesn't have to come first: Podría *elegir* otra alternativa si *fuera* posible states the consequence before the condition, and the meaning doesn't change either way.
